limitations: Oracle controls are protected reference repairs and are not deployable model methods.
A deterministic control has no model-origin abstention decision. Compare repair-only denominators when contrasting it with an LLM.
This is a public, designed task suite, including adapted upstream tasks, not a random sample of production failures or a hidden held-out benchmark.
The independent unit is the base case. Injection variants and repeated executions do not increase the number of cases. Related families can remain correlated.
A case succeeds only when every registered repetition in that condition succeeds. Missing, invalid and interrupted executions remain in conservative registered denominators.
Wilson 95% intervals summarize designed base-case outcomes descriptively. They do not establish population coverage or causal method superiority.
Paired method and clean/injection comparisons report both registered pairs and completely verified pairs, including exclusions.
A successful runtime flag alone is insufficient: candidate replay, actual model response identity and usage, model/image pins, runtime identities and cleanup must agree.
Artifacts are trusted worker execution records with content hashes, not signed hardware attestation. Offline reporting does not rerun Kubernetes.
Wall time is the worker's elapsed measurement. Generation time is reconstructed by summing integer raw nanoseconds once before division. Missing usage is unavailable, never zero.
Methods can use different call/feedback budgets. Compare their actual measured tokens, model calls and wall time alongside repair outcomes.

public_requirements: Preserve existing resource identities, names, labels, replica counts, images and trusted application commands.

All init and application containers must explicitly set privileged=false, runAsNonRoot=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and readOnlyRootFilesystem=true; use positive non-root UIDs, drop ALL capabilities and use RuntimeDefault seccomp.
Preserve each stated application UID/GID and required behavior; only task-owned volume mounts and bounded permission fields may be adjusted.

command:
import json, os, ssl, time, urllib.request, urllib.error
from pathlib import Path
root='/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount'
token=Path(root+'/token').read_text()
context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=root+'/ca.crt')
host='https://'+os.environ['KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST']+':'+os.environ['KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT_HTTPS']
for attempt in range(900):
 try:
  request=urllib.request.Request(host+'/api/v1/namespaces/__NAMESPACE__/configmaps', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
  value=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(request, context=context, timeout=3))
  assert set(['runtime-config']).issubset({item['metadata']['name'] for item in value['items']})
  print('runtime listed required configmap', flush=True)
  break
 except (urllib.error.URLError, AssertionError, OSError) as exc:
  print(type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc), flush=True); time.sleep(1)
else: raise SystemExit('runtime API contract not satisfied')
